description: Dataset för SOU 2023:18 Värdet av vinden - Kompensation, incitament och planering för en hållbar fortsatt utbyggnad av vindkraften is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by M 2022:03, Stärkta incitament för utbyggd vindkraft. It is not possible to provide access to all parts of the data material as openly accessible data. Please refer to the table of contents (Arkivförteckning[...].xlsx) and note that some files are only available through the Swedish National Archives. The study is a Governmental Inquiry Commission (SOU). Coverage: M 2022:03, Stärkta incitament för utbyggd vindkraft. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset for SOU 2023:18 The Wind's Value - Compensation, Incentives and Planning for a Continued Sustainable Wind Power " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is M 2022:03, Stärkta incitament för utbyggd vindkraft. Its keywords include land use planning, statlig offentlig utredning, ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE, ENERGIPOLITIK, planering av markanvändning, vindkraftsstation. The listing shows 2024-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
